## What's new in 2.3.1

- **Demo mode with application login.** A demo instance (`FREEREPS_DEMO=true`) with `methods: [password]` had no account that could see the generated data, because it belongs to user 1 and no login led there. `FREEREPS_DEMO_PASSWORD` now gives that user the login `demo`. A regular installation is not affected.
- **README**: the iOS app 2.3 is in App Store review; until it is released, keep Tailscale enabled on the server.

Everything else is as in [2.3.0](https://github.com/meltforce/FreeReps/releases/tag/2.3.0), including the notes on running without Tailscale.
